errors.text_span: с равни интервали от едно тримесечие
errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis labels are at equal intervals of one quarter. However, the labels shown on the axis (e.g., 2003Q1, 2004Q2, 2005Q3) are spaced at intervals of five quarters, not one.

errors.text_span: след което се вдига до връх от около 450,0 в 2011Q1
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the peak of approximately 450.0 occurred in 2011Q1. According to the chart, this peak value is reached in 2013Q1. The value in 2011Q1 is much lower, around 350-360.
